name: forward-referencing-global-definition-test-c1122b914e/global-var-order-v
reason: The case exercises module-variable initialization with a transitive forward reference through incI: i must initialize to 0 before j and k call incI, yielding i=2, j=1, k=2. Module variables, functions, calls, assignments, integer addition, tuple/list construction and indexed access are supported without an initialization-order restriction. All three asserted outputs therefore fall within the supported behavior.
test_design_notes: The @output assertions require 2, 1, 2 in order; there are no @args or @panic directives.
